Mahanadi Steel Corporation 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Tamil Nadu · IN 
 
 
 No. CC/44/2014/019 
 Dated: 2026-03-31 
 
 Certificate of Completion of Work 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "Substation EPC - Tamil Nadu Pkg-19" (industrial epc), awarded to M/
 s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been completed in
 all respects on 2014-08-13 at a gross executed value of INR 15,39,00,000/- (Rupees 15.39 Crore Only).
 
 The work has been completed in all respects as per the approved drawings, specifications, and contract
 conditions. The quality of work has been found satisfactory during the final inspection carried out by the
 undersigned. 
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Suresh Chopra. This certificate is issued for record and
 for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance.
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Mahanadi Steel Corporation
